notes: The function builds an index table with 0x545 entries, passes the exact PS4/Animation/MlbCrowdCore.xbn pointer (0x7001d4a005) with that table to the asset helper, and participates in animation-resource setup; adjacent caller sequence supports the role.

Body handles the options record and nested cleanup/setup using GAMETUNING_SAVE_OPTIONS (0x7001d50a4d) and GAMETUNING_DONT_SAVE_OPTIONS (0x7001c899c9) keys. No indexed direct caller, but local behavior supports the proposed scope.

Formats and resolves the two exact batting/pitching patch paths at 0x7001cc4880 and 0x7001d37c55, then activates the corresponding resource slots. The caller in the same setup sequence tailcalls this routine.
Reads PlayerList and total_pages via the full-address keys 0x7001d504a5 and 0x7001d34de1, computes page count bounds and clamps the stored page field. No indexed caller; body supports the label.
Looks up CUR_PLAYER (0x7001c64cc0), then id (0x7001cd3b91) and type_id (0x7001d587b0), validates the value and initializes the associated composite record when present. No indexed direct caller.
Looks up current_row (0x7001cd5670), then the row color key (0x7001ce9e19), and passes the resolved value to the color helper. This supports the row-color resolver label; no indexed direct caller.
